env.buildPhase:
runHook preBuild
export HOME="$TMPDIR/home"
export GRADLE_USER_HOME="$TMPDIR/gradle-home"
# Seatbelt rejects IPv4-mapped IPv6 loopback connects used by the JVM.
# Apply to the launcher, daemon and workers inside this Nix build only.
export JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS="${JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS:+$JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS }-Djava.net.preferIPv4Stack=true"

export GRADLE_PURIFIER_MODE=sandbox
export GRADLE_PURIFIER_LEGACY_PUBLICATIONS='[]'
export GRADLE_PURIFIER_BUILD_ROOT="$PWD"
export GRADLE_PURIFIER_REPOSITORY=file:///nix/store/1hjix16cpkzl86fk34q2hjphwsrnva3g-gradle-purifier-repository
export GRADLE_PURIFIER_RESOURCES=/nix/store/9x8dfvcdpqwr4zhj6cj9wijjdw0ys0jk-gradle-external-resources.json

export GRADLE_PURIFIER_OUTPUT="$TMPDIR/purifier-output"
export GRADLE_PURIFIER_CHECK=1

export JAVA_HOME=/nix/store/al24k44gwd1rk08p1x2p4r88ba9xw132-zulu-ca-jdk-17.0.19
mkdir -p "$HOME" "$GRADLE_USER_HOME"

GRADLE_PURIFIER_MODE="" /nix/store/0jb1qn7qnpbz8774mq5k2c1p84gp0x76-python3-3.14.8/bin/python /nix/store/7mrjkgpm9b03s1wq4g39466jf87hm28v-gradle-flags.py sandbox "$TMPDIR/gradle-help.txt" \
  --gradle /nix/store/yvgf360hi0g0qf6ksiiqvzckwzvpqv1s-gradle-8.14.6-purifier-darwin-worker-ipv4/bin/gradle \
  --arguments-json '[]' > "$TMPDIR/gradle-flags.txt"
mapfile -t gradleFlags < "$TMPDIR/gradle-flags.txt"
sourceDiscoveryArgs=(-Porg.gradle.java.installations.auto-detect=false '-Porg.gradle.java.installations.paths=/nix/store/al24k44gwd1rk08p1x2p4r88ba9xw132-zulu-ca-jdk-17.0.19')

status=0
/nix/store/yvgf360hi0g0qf6ksiiqvzckwzvpqv1s-gradle-8.14.6-purifier-darwin-worker-ipv4/bin/gradle \
  --init-script /nix/store/splxxfzxha8wnx4hrmixycawmlkj7r3f-gradle-purifier-lib/purifier.init.gradle \
  --init-script /nix/store/z4kwlfsjjv8r3m6zv62siaghmackjq8j-task-jdks.init.gradle \
  -Dorg.gradle.internal.plugins.portal.url.override=file:///nix/store/1hjix16cpkzl86fk34q2hjphwsrnva3g-gradle-purifier-repository/https/plugins.gradle.org/m2 \
  -Dorg.gradle.native=false \
  -Djava.io.tmpdir="$TMPDIR" \
  -Porg.gradle.java.installations.auto-download=false \
  "${sourceDiscoveryArgs[@]}" \
  -Pkotlin.compiler.execution.strategy=in-process \
   \
  :purifierBuild --offline "${gradleFlags[@]}" --stacktrace </dev/null 2> >(tee "$TMPDIR/gradle-errors" >&2) || status=$?
wait
if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
  if grep -q -e 'Could not find' -e 'Could not resolve' "$TMPDIR/gradle-errors" \
    && grep -q -F /nix/store/1hjix16cpkzl86fk34q2hjphwsrnva3g-gradle-purifier-repository "$TMPDIR/gradle-errors"; then
    echo "gradle-purifier: the build needs a file that gradle-purifier.lock.json does not hold (Gradle names it above); run 'gradle-purifier lock --relock'." >&2
  fi
  exit "$status"
fi

          /nix/store/0jb1qn7qnpbz8774mq5k2c1p84gp0x76-python3-3.14.8/bin/python /nix/store/2qmdcr03s9i03165dvshp69w5msmd0cm-export-runtime.py /nix/store/00ksslrh26ddw0ym37xiqgggfl9zqrsa-jvm_repository.py \
    "$GRADLE_PURIFIER_OUTPUT/spring-petclinic/runtime-data.json" \
    /nix/store/1hjix16cpkzl86fk34q2hjphwsrnva3g-gradle-purifier-repository "$runtime" "$localPublications" /nix/store/pr65akibn0y1cyzycg7scf9vbgrjzya5-gradle-provided-dependencies-metadata/catalog.json
runHook postBuild
env.installPhase:
runHook preInstall
built="$GRADLE_PURIFIER_OUTPUT/spring-petclinic"
mkdir -p "$out"


mkdir -p "$out/share/archives"
for archive in spring-petclinic-plain.jar spring-petclinic.jar; do
  if [ ! -f "$built/archives/$archive" ]; then
    echo "gradle-purifier: the lock names the archive $archive, which this build of spring-petclinic did not make; run 'gradle-purifier lock'." >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  cp "$built/archives/$archive" "$out/share/archives/$archive"
done


runHook postInstall
env.name: spring-petclinic
